evals.prompt: An assistant can answer from documents and send external messages. The proposed safety plan is a system prompt saying never leak data plus a second-model reviewer. Design a layered guardrail matrix, enforcement points, outage behavior and acceptance tests without excessive approvals on harmless answers.
evals.expected_output: Layered enforceable controls and proportional friction.
expectations: Does not treat prompt or reviewer agreement as a security/authorization boundary.
Places permissions/data policy and required approval before external send.
Separates schema/semantic validation, runtime limits and grounded output checks.
Fails closed for required boundary outages while allowing explicitly safe read-only degradation.

evals.prompt: An output filter runs only after an email tool sends; a policy checker outage defaults to allow; a reviewer model approves an over-limit payment; retries bypass validation. Show concrete release-gate failures and the corrected execution path.
expectations: Blocks release for post-send-only protection and moves admission before execution.
Denies effects during required policy outage and rejects over-limit payment despite reviewer approval.
Enforces the same admission controls on retry/resume paths.
Defines no-effect tests and operational/false-blocking measurements.

evals.prompt: Validate a deterministic web form: required email, maximum message length and numeric age range. There is no LLM or agent runtime.
expectations: Uses ordinary schema/input validation without agent guardrail orchestration.
Does not introduce model reviewers, runtime step budgets or approval gates.

evals.prompt: Guardrails deny a first installment plan [40,40] for required total100. A supported permitted candidate [40,60] exists. The product currently refuses immediately; the team alternatively wants to skip sum/permission checks after model repair. Design layered behavior including no authorized valid candidate, required checker outage and approval changes. No live execution.
evals.expected_output: Bounded constructive path without enforcement bypass.
expectations: Constructs/repairs the supported alternative and revalidates/re-authorizes under unchanged constraints rather than lazy terminal refusal.
Does not skip policy/permission/semantic checks after repair or allow human/model approval to waive hard invariants.
Bounds search and fails closed when no candidate or required checker exists while testing false blocking of valid candidates.
